page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top; a woodcut of a lizard-like animal in the centre; imprint lines below the woodcut. No columns or margin text. A library stamp (NATIONAL... CANCELLED) and a handwritten number 486 at top right are not transcribed.

main_text.l: in Schola Tigurina, Historiæ Animalium Liber II.
NVNC DENVO RECOGNITVS AC PLVRIBVS IN
locis ab ipso authore ante obitum emendatus & auctus, atq; aliquot nouis Iconibus
& descriptionibus locupletatus, ac denique breuibus in margine Annotationibus illustratus.
super nominibus Ouiparorum quadrupedum in totidem linguis diuersis: & ante
illos Enumeratio eo ordine quo in hoc volumine continentur.
Cum gratia & priuilegio S. Cæsareæ Maiestatis ad decennium.

page.notes: A woodcut of a lizard-like quadruped with a frilled back stands between the subtitle block and the imprint. A faint pencilled "1586" appears below the date and is not transcribed. The library stamp at top is not transcribed.
